title: Concrete flat telescopes and their stage-induced morphisms
statement: For a scheme Y, let A be its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and q the quotient from cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] to their homotopy category. For E_n bounded-above complexes with flat terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] and t_n:E_n→E_(n+1), put d(E,t)=id−Sigma.desc(t_n;ι_(n+1)) and Tel(E,t)=Cone(d(E,t)). A flat telescope is literally such a cone; a telescope-shift representative is q(Tel(E,t)) or its translate by one. A stage-induced morphism s:X→Xprime is e^(-1);q(Cone.map(Sigma.map(a),Sigma.map(a))) [k];eprime, for two such towers, an integer k, homotopy isomorphisms e:q(Tel(E,t))[k]≅X and eprime:q(Tel(Eprime,tprime))[k]≅Xprime, and a_n:E_n→Eprime_n whose sum satisfies d(E,t);Sigma.map(a)=Sigma.map(a);d(Eprime,tprime). All cone maps and their sum maps are explicitly constructed; no existence witness chooses data.
